verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships several built-in AI features — AI-generated incident summaries, an AI 'Copilot' that proactively surfaces suggestions, AI-drafted retrospectives, and an AI meeting 'Scribe' that transcribes/captures incident bridge discussions — which function as task-specific AI assistance embedded in the product. However, these are fixed, single-purpose AI features (summarize, draft, transcribe, suggest) rather than a general-purpose conversational assistant to which a user can delegate arbitrary tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of a general chat-style AI assistant that accepts open-ended task delegation (e.g., 'create this runbook', 'investigate this alert') beyond the fixed summary/draft/transcription features, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI capabilities.
